scripts.build:yaegi: cd packages/yaegi-runtime && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -ldflags='-s -w' -o npm/yaegi.wasm . && cp -f "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" npm/wasm_exec.js && cp -f "$(go list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' github.com/traefik/yaegi)/LICENSE" npm/LICENSE-yaegi && cp -f "$(go env GOROOT)/LICENSE" npm/LICENSE-go
